assets.name: cc-cast
assets.prompt: Three full-body contemporary dancers in a neutral front-facing T pose, arms straight horizontally at shoulder height, separated with clear space. Left dancer: deep brown skin, short natural dark curls, blue short sleeve top, charcoal slim rehearsal trousers, blue soft dance shoes, tall lean build. Center dancer: warm light brown skin, dark hair tied in a bun, rust orange short sleeve top, charcoal rehearsal trousers, rust soft dance shoes, broad strong build. Right dancer: light skin, short wavy brown hair, teal short sleeve top, charcoal rehearsal trousers, teal soft dance shoes, shorter stockier build. Natural older teen or adult proportions, relaxed faces, clothed studio performers, a natural range of gender presentation. Whole bodies, fingers and shoes visible. All three at the same scale and on a common floor line. Front orthographic view. Arms perfectly horizontal, straight legs separated hip width. Editorial gouache with colored pencil texture and soft light from upper left. Isolated on flat pure green #00FF00. This is an articulated animation source, so limbs must be clearly separated, wrists and elbows visible. No shadows on the green backdrop. No lettering or logos.
assets.production_note: One neutral pose per performer, articulated by the original engine skeleton. Registration and painted-render adapter live in src.html.
assets.review: Inspected full cast and runtime cutouts; varied skin tones, builds and gender presentation. Contact sheet in scratch.

assets.name: cc-floor-cast
assets.prompt: Editorial gouache matching the cc-cast reference exactly. A clean three column by three row contact sheet of nine full-body floor dance poses, each isolated in its own equal square cell on pure green #00FF00. Columns are the same blue top dark brown skinned dancer, rust top warm brown skinned broad dancer, teal top light skinned stocky dancer, with charcoal trousers and matching soft shoes. Row one: kneeling sitting back on heels, upright torso, hands resting naturally near thighs, three-quarter front view. Row two: kneeling on heels curled forward, head gently lowered, forearms wrapping above the head, a compact rounded protective shape with shoulders clearly visible, three-quarter view. Row three: lying on the back along the floor, head at left and feet at right, arms extended beyond the head along the floor, viewed from slightly above and from the side. Keep all hands, heads and feet fully inside their cells with clear green gutters. Same individual faces, hair, bodies and clothing as the cast reference. Respectful, ordinary rehearsal movement, anatomically clear, warm directional upper-left light. No writing, letters, numbers, logos or props.
assets.production_note: Three necessary floor poses per performer complement the single neutral articulated pose. Full 3x3 canvas registration is preserved by keyed reprocessing.
assets.review: Inspected raw and keyed nine-pose cast; anatomical kneeling, curled protective gesture and lying on back, no lettering. Runtime bounds registered in FLOOR_RECTS.
